# Pinned pstack resources

Source: https://github.com/backnotprop/pstack
Revision: `124f622bcaeac490e7e9dac6af83f3ef9611d554`

`skills/` and `LICENSE` are unchanged upstream files.
`UPSTREAM.json` records their SHA-256 hashes.
Keep sibling skills and relative resources together when updating this snapshot.

These are explicitly read resources, outside harness skill-discovery directories.
Nothing installs a plugin, registers skill names, runs setup, or activates a workflow merely because these files exist.
The shared ship contract names the entry file and overrides publication and pipeline duties.
Read routed leaf skills from this tree rather than similarly named global skills.
